card.name: Procedure nouns after 'the' or 'prior to'
card.fires_on: Procedure or preparation nouns such as injection, test, solution, infusion, treatment and experiment. They come after 'the', 'prior to', 'previous' or 'after starting', mostly in instructions.

modes.label: Injection steps
modes.description: The word injection after 'prior to', 'throughout the' or 'previous' in dosing instructions.
modes.example: Do not attempt to activate the needle safety guard prior to<< injection>>.

modes.label: Prepared solution or infusion
modes.description: Solution or infusion after 'reconstituted' or 'prepared' in storage and preparation steps.
modes.example: Discard any unused portion of the reconstituted<< solution>>.

modes.label: Other procedures
modes.description: Test, treatment or experiment as the thing being done in general guidance text.
modes.example: How do I get ready for this<< test>>?

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the noun naming the procedure being described, like injection, test or infusion, in step-by-step instructions.
